title: Gabriel Knight: Sins of the Fathers

note.default: The build takes about 5 minutes and 1.5 GB. Python (with pefile and capstone) and the Visual Studio Build Tools with clang-cl (about 4 GB, 15 to 30 minutes more) are installed if they are missing. Choose the DOS CD's drive, a folder copy of it, or an .iso. Early: it plays day 1 in the bookshop, with no sound yet.
